title: Ansel and the Letters
author: Cyrus Yarrow
blurb: Tamsin Vane, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
